zero_slop_policy.statement: NO AI SLOP ALLOWED AT ALL - ZERO TOLERANCE TO SLOP AND HALLUCINATIONS
zero_slop_policy.strict_compliance: Mandatory. Every claim must be project-specific, evidence-backed, trace-linked, reviewer-challenged, and free of unsupported invention.
zero_slop_policy.missing_evidence_rule: If evidence is missing, mark it as an assumption, risk, open question, or failure.

generated_skill.name: product-tailored-dark-factory-meta-skill
generated_skill.purpose: Generate and run a product-specific dark-factory workflow with tailored SDLC stages, artifacts, tests, ledgers, graph, gates, and judge/jury controls.
trigger_conditions: project asks for rigorous SDLC/dark-factory execution
refusal_rules: refuse generic process without product tailoring
refuse product completion without required implementation/test evidence
refuse UI completion without browser/WYSIWYG evidence
refuse scenario-driven completion without scenario/holdout/transfer evidence
refuse any transition not allowed by TASKS.md, TPM flow, PERT, KG, execution kernel, and judge/jury gate

compile_time_outputs.methodology_blend_record: df-methodology-blender output required per generated project

gates: browser/Playwright/WYSIWYG evidence required when UI surface is true
contract/API tests required when API surface is true
schema, migration, validation, privacy, and rollback gates required when data surface is true
rollback, observability, runbook, incident path, and outage drill required when production surface is true

expert_panel.meta_meta_compiler_critic: Elite systems/compiler critic responsible for ensuring meta-meta output compiles into a real generated meta-skill rather than prose.
expert_panel.product_sdlc_tailoring_critic: Elite SDLC tailoring critic responsible for product-specific lifecycle, artifact, methodology, and risk fit.
expert_panel.testing_and_release_assurance_critic: Elite verification/release critic responsible for code, scenario, browser, performance, release, and production evidence gates.
expert_panel.adversarial_generic_process_critic: Adversarial critic responsible for attacking generic process, document-only completion, skipped stages, and fake proof.

residual_risks: Future real product runs must instantiate their own product profile, stage matrix, artifacts, code evidence, tests, browser evidence, and production evidence.
